levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

notes: «حدثنا أبي» opens the chain: the compiler's father, bare, so relation
«بإسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap (rule 8), placed before the Imam
«أبي عبد الله» is written after «إلى» inside the chain, so narrator by analogy with «عن»; the Prophet's saying follows as «قال»
